adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and applies it directly to the query (`group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)`) without any maximum clamp. Since this is the public `groups_controller` endpoint (not admin) and `find_group` only checks `guardian.ensure_can_see!(group)`, a caller who can view the group can request an arbitrarily large `limit`, potentially forcing large DB work and response sizes.
